jobs.title: MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Company description:
Scandinavian Airlines System SAS
Job description:  Challenges you will work on 
At SAS, machine learning has moved well beyond experimentation. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in machine learning, automation, data platforms, and Generative AI. We design, deploy, and operate production models that support pricing decisions, personalize customer experiences, and make our operations smarter every day.
 As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will play an important role in developing, deploying, and maintaining machine learning solutions that create real business value. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, and AI engineers to help bring models from development into production and ensure they perform reliably at scale.
 If you're passionate about applying machine learning to real-world challenges and want to help shape the future of AI at SAS, this is the role for you!
 As our Machine Learning Engineer, you will help develop and operationalize machine learning solutions across SAS. In this role, you will work hands-on with deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of production ML solutions.
 You will collaborate closely with data scientists to transition models from experimentation to production, help improve deployment processes and contribute to the ongoing development of our ML platform and engineering practices.
 Key Responsibilities
  Design, develop, test, deploy and monitor end-to-end pipelines for machine learning models in Azure.
 Apply MLOps best practices, including version control, continuous integration, continuous delivery, continuous training, testing, and monitoring, to ensure the quality and reliability of the machine learning solutions.
 Monitor model performance and help identify issues related to model quality, drift, and reliability.
 Support automation of model training, deployment, and retraining processes.
 Contribute to best practices for machine learning engineering, testing, documentation, and deployment.
 Work with Data Engineering and IT teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and reliable.
 Help develop and improve CI/CD processes for machine learning applications.
 Participate in troubleshooting and resolving issues in production ML systems.
 Stay up to date with developments in machine learning, MLOps, and cloud technologies.
  The Team 
We are a central AI & Automation function within SAS Digital & IT that develops and operates solutions across machine learning, automation, MLOps, and Generative AI. Our team consists of data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, and automation specialists who work together to deliver solutions that create measurable business impact.
 As SAS continues to strengthen its AI capabilities, we are investing in modern cloud platforms, scalable AI solutions, and engineering practices that enable machine learning to create value across the business.
 As part of the team, you will contribute to a growing portfolio of machine learning products and collaborate across disciplines to ensure solutions are production-ready, scalable, and valuable to the business.
 To be successful we believe you have  Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Machine Learning, Mathematics, or a related field.
 2-5 years of experience in Machine Learning Engineering, MLOps, or a related role.
 Experience developing, deploying, and operating machine learning solutions in production environments.
 Hands-on experience with Azure ML, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or similar cloud-based ML platforms.
 Proficiency in Python, SQL, Git, and Bash.
 Experience deploying and serving machine learning models through APIs, as well as monitoring model performance in production.
 Understanding of model evaluation techniques, hyperparameter tuning, and validation approaches such as back-testing.
 Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform on Azure.
 Solid understanding of software engineering practices, including testing, version control, and CI/CD principles.
 Strong communication skills and the ability to explain and document technical concepts clearly and effectively.
 Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI agents is considered a plus.
  
We believe you are a curious and pragmatic engineer who enjoys solving problems with data and machine learning. You are comfortable working across the ML lifecycle, from experimentation to production, and enjoy collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines.
 You are eager to learn, improve your technical skills, and contribute to building reliable AI solutions that create real business value. Most importantly, you understand that successful machine learning is not only about models, but about delivering solutions that work in the real world and continue to provide value over time.
  
 Additional information  Apply by November 16, 2026. We review applications continuously and encourage you to apply early, as the position may be filled before the closing date. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept applications via email.
 This is a full-time position (100%) based at our headquarters in Frösundavik, Solna, Stockholm. We value in-person collaboration, although flexible working arrangements may be available depending on team and business needs.
 As this role contributes to security-classified systems and business-critical capabilities, a background check will be conducted as part of the final stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
At MedHelp Care, we’re shaping the future of workplace health management. As a leading Nordic B2B SaaS company, we build intelligent AI-powered platforms that help organizations create healthier workplaces.
Our platform uses advanced health data analytics and machine learning to detect early signals of health risk, enabling companies to take proactive, preventive action. Our mission is clear: to make workplaces healthier, more resilient, and better equipped to support both employees and organizations.
We are on an exciting growth journey and we’re now looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join us.
About the role
You'll join our data team that develops InsightsHub and Statistics, our customer-facing analytics products; Larix, our model for flagging who's at risk of long-term sick leave; and the data platform underneath.
We use agentic coding tools heavily, and expect how we build to keep changing. We care less about which tools you use today than whether you're willing to keep changing how you work.
Larix, and how we run models in production generally, is at the centre of this role. We're a small shop, so things move fast and what you build shapes the product rather than a corner of it.
What we’re recruiting for
Larix, our long-term sick leave risk model: retraining, serving and monitoring it in production, plus features, evaluation, performance and making it work in new markets.
How we run models in production generally - serving, evaluation and monitoring.

What the team owns and you’ll work across
InsightsHub, our LLM-based analytics product: the data model and pipelines underneath, and the generation on top.
The transformation layer: dbt, warehouse, orchestration.
Product and usage data, with a focus on making it self-serve.
Proving what the product does to sickness absence, in a way that holds up with customers and leadership.

Who we think you are
You write Python and SQL that other people can maintain.
You've looked after a model in production over time, not just built one and moved on.
You've automated a training or deployment pipeline, or you're keen to.
You can design an evaluation that survives scrutiny, and you know the difference between correlation, prediction, and causal effect.
You've worked with dbt or equivalent and an orchestrator like Airflow, Prefect or Dagster.
You can explain what the numbers mean to someone who isn't technical.
We're open to a few years of experience and up. The right person matters more than years of experience.

Nice to have
Taking a model to a new market or population.
Evaluating LLM or AI output in production.
Experience with privacy and sensitive personal data.
Domain background in HR, occupational health, insurance, or healthcare.

About MedHelp Care
MedHelp Care AB is a leading SaaS company offering an AI-powered, cloud-based platform for data-driven corporate health and expert medical advisory services. Used by around 500 companies in the Nordics and connecting up to 200,000 employees, our platform helps reduce sick leave, increase employee presence, and lower costs.
Founded in 1999, we operate in Sweden, Finland, and Denmark with a team of around 45 employees.
Our mission is to improve employee health through proactive, data-driven initiatives and contribute to a healthier society by halving long-term sick leave. At the heart of this mission is a machine learning model that helps us identify and address health risks proactively. If you're motivated by applying machine learning to health, and you'd rather work across the whole lifecycle of a model at a small company than on one slice of it at a large one, this role is for you.
In this recruitment, we are collaborating with Safemind, and all applications will be processed through them.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Konsert Strategy & IP is a leading consultancy at the intersection of business strategy, technology and intellectual property. Founded in Gothenburg in 2006, we work with some of the world's largest technology-intensive companies, close to the leaders who decide where to compete and how to win through technology and IP. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group.

Like every consultancy, we are adapting to an environment that AI is reshaping. Much of the research, analysis and preparation that used to fill a project team's weeks can now be done by machines.

Our clients face the same shift from the other side. Their strategy, technology and IP functions are under a clear mandate to work faster and leaner with AI. But today's landscape of point tools depends on the user to supply the context, and without it the tools speed up the doing without improving the thinking.

What clients still need is sound judgment, grounded in the right context. That is where the real value of AI lies: not in faster work, but in better, more reliable and more impactful decisions. So rather than defend the old consultancy model, we are rebuilding ours around that: consultants who work inside our clients' organizations, supported by an AI platform that holds the client's context. That platform is Sapivia. We are now growing our in-house tech team, to make sure we have the capabilities under our own roof to take Sapivia to the next level.

**What we are building: Sapivia**

Sapivia is Konsert's AI platform. At its core is the context layer: a client-specific knowledge graph that holds the context every decision depends on. How the business, its technology and its intellectual property connect, what depends on what, and the reasoning behind the decisions already made. We have built that picture for clients by hand for twenty years; Sapivia captures it, keeps it alive and makes it available to people and AI alike.

Our consultants build the context layer together with the client. The client's own people, Konsert's forward-deployed strategists and the AI tools the client already uses can then reason and act on the same picture, one that grows richer over time.

Sapivia is already in use with clients, starting in IP, where the need is sharpest. But the same picture answers the questions every technology company has to ask: which technologies matter, where to compete and how to turn knowledge into advantage. That is where we are taking it next.

**The Konsert tech core team**

We are building a small tech core team: a handful of engineers with complementary skills. The team is led by a Tech Lead and sits in Gothenburg, next to the consultants who deploy Sapivia with clients. Build work happens in close collaboration with those consultants, several of whom spend part of their time in the team, so the domain expertise and the client's reality are in the room when we build.

We work in an agile way with shared ownership: everyone is close to the users, effort goes where it is needed, and the team ships several times a week and owns the result together. Development runs in close alignment with Konsert's leadership team, with short paths to user input and quick decisions. The tech core team has a central voice in how Sapivia is shaped. Around this core, we scale with external developers and the Rouse Group's technology organization.

**Questions we are working on right now**

Giving AI the right context is only the start. Turning that context into decisions that large companies can rely on raises questions that few teams have answered yet. These are some of the ones we are working on now. They are open questions, not tickets, and you will help answer them.

* How do we assure the quality of AI responses at scale, when the right answer is often a matter of judgment?
* How do we best combine deep domain knowledge with what the models already know?
* How do we make a rich, connected body of knowledge feel simple and intuitive to work with?
* How do we give large organizations precise control over who sees what, across regions, teams and many users?
* How do we shorten the path from prototype to production code, while keeping the freedom to experiment?

**The role: Applied AI engineer**

You bring the applied AI competence to the core team. Sapivia's AI features run on the client-specific knowledge graph as their context layer, and the hard problems are in the harness around the models: retrieval, context management, tools, guardrails, evaluation and feedback loops. You take LLM-based features from first prompt to production, set up the evaluation that assures their quality, and help the team decide where AI creates value and where it does not. You work closely with the consultants whose judgment the system is meant to support.

**What you bring**

* Several years (likely 5+) of professional experience as a software engineer
* Experience building and shipping LLM-based features in a real product, including prompt design and systematic evaluation
* Experience with retrieval over structured and unstructured data, ideally combining graph traversal with vector search and embeddings
* Experience designing the harness around models: tool use, context management, guardrails and agent loops that run server-side with controlled budgets
* Comfort working in TypeScript or C#, the main languages of the platform; Python experience is welcome
* Experience with Azure OpenAI or comparable hosted model services, and with data pipelines and data quality, is a plus
* A habit of using AI effectively in your own work, and of measuring rather than assuming

**Who we are looking for**

You are an experienced engineer who has shipped software that real users depend on. Where you have worked matters less than what you have built. If you are more senior and want to shape a platform and a team from an early stage, we would like to talk to you too.

Beyond that, we look for four things:

* You share ownership of the outcome. You care about what the team ships, not only your part of it, and you help get the work done where it is needed.
* You are curious about the domain and the users. You want to understand what a better decision looks like for the people we build for, and you like working with consultants as closely as with other engineers.
* You use AI seriously in your own work, and you understand that AI in a product is only valuable when it is reliable and well grounded. Evaluation and guardrails interest you as much as capability does.
* You like building. You take initiative, form a view and can explain it, and you are comfortable when the playbook is still being written.

If most of this describes you, please get in touch. Nobody matches every line, and we would rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out.

**Why Konsert**

**Help shape the model.** We are building a service and a technology business together. The platform you build is what our consultants deploy, and your engineering judgment will shape our methods, our product and what we offer next.

**See it in use.** You will see your work in clients' real decisions and operations, and hear from the consultants next to you how it lands.

**Responsibility, with experience beside you.** We are a team of around twenty with a flat structure. You will take on responsibility early, with a Tech Lead and senior colleagues to support you.

**A solid base.** Konsert has an established position in technology strategy and business-driven IP, and Sapivia is already in use with clients. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group, which gives us specialist expertise, technology resources and a wider client network.

 You will bringYou are curious and pragmatic, take initiative, ask questions and work well across disciplines. jobs.title: AI Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Backend Engineer to build the core intelligence layer of a fast-scaling AI company backed by NVIDIA, Microsoft, and AWS.
About Antrino
Antrino Labs is building the platform that makes every square meter intelligent.
The physical world runs on processes nobody can actually see. Goods move, machines idle, space goes unused, and decisions about all of it are based on samples, guesses, and reports written after the fact. Antrino lets any organization deploy vision intelligence into a physical space and get back what is actually happening there, as structured, real-time information it can act on. Not a research project or a custom integration, but a platform where you describe what matters and deploy it.
We have grown from 6 people to a team of 28 in less than a year, closed our Seed round, announced together with Dagens Industri, and are registered with Inspektionen för strategiska produkter (ISP), the Swedish authority for strategic and dual-use products. Everything we build follows Privacy by Design.
The role
You will build the services that turn a customer's intent into working intelligence.
When a customer builds something in Studio, our composition canvas, that graph has to become a running system: a plan that decides which models to call, in what order, gated by cost and confidence, and that produces events and evidence a customer can trust. You will work on the compiler that turns the graph into an execution plan, the runtime that executes it, and the Python and TypeScript services that detection, classification, and measurement run through.
You will also work on our Agent, which interviews customers, proposes and edits these graphs, and deploys them with confirmation. Getting an LLM to reliably manipulate a structured graph, validate it, and explain its reasoning is a real engineering problem, not a prompting exercise.
The role sits between the team building our first-party detection models and the engineers building the product interface. It is backend systems engineering for a product whose core logic is built out of AI calls.
What you will work on
Backend services for detection, classification, and measurement, largely in Python with FastAPI
The compiler that turns a Studio graph into an execution plan, and the runtime that deploys and runs it
Routing logic that decides which model handles which work, including cost gating where a cheap model decides when an expensive one runs
The Agent's interview, graph-editing, and deployment flows that turn natural language into a working pipeline
Integrating our first-party detection models, and frontier model APIs where they do something ours do not yet, behind one clean interface
Turning raw model output into structured, auditable events and evidence an operator can trust
APIs and data models for streams, behaviors, runs, and events in PostgreSQL with row-level security
Tests and evaluation harnesses for logic that includes non-deterministic model calls
Debugging production issues that span a customer request, our orchestration, and the model call underneath



Our stack
You do not need experience with all of this, but you should recognize most of it and be able to argue about it.
Backend: Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, Node.jsData: PostgreSQL through Supabase, with row-level security, 
Streaming: RTSP ingestion, RTSP→HLS conversion, live and archive pipelines
Infrastructure: Azure, GitHub Actions, on-site compute reached over Tailscale
Who we are looking for Substantial backend experience on production systems, ideally where an LLM or ML model was part of the core logic rather than a bolted-on feature
Strong Python, and comfort in TypeScript or Node.js
Real experience designing APIs, data models, and service boundaries, including PostgreSQL
Experience building with LLM APIs beyond a chat wrapper: tool use, structured output, agentic flows, or a model as one step in a larger pipeline
An understanding of how to test systems with non-deterministic components
Experience with real-time or streaming data is a strong advantage
Excellent written and spoken English. Swedish is a plus, not a requirement



You can reason about a graph or compiler-shaped problem even if you have never built a compiler. You make decisions with incomplete information, take responsibility for the outcome, and say so clearly when something you built was wrong.
Life at Antrino
You will join a team of driven, ambitious people who thrive at a fast pace and enjoy working together. We go to AI events, host our own, and end plenty of weeks with an afterwork. You will work closely with our engineers in Stockholm and our growing team in Bangalore.
What we offer
Direct access to the founders, the engineering team, and customers
Real ownership of a core layer of the platform rather than delegated tickets
Potential participation in our stock option programme after the probationary period
Hardware of your choice
AI events, afterworks, team activities, and travel when the business requires it
Occupational pension, insurance, and friskvårdsbidrag



Process
Introductory conversation about your background and the role
Technical conversation about systems you have built and why you made the decisions you made. No whiteboard algorithm puzzles
Working session with the engineering team on a real problem from our stack
Conversation with the founders about options and terms



We review applications continuously. References may be requested at the final stage.
Apply with your CV and, if you have one, a link to something you have built. A repository, a shipped product, or a short note about a system you are proud of tells us more than a cover letter

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Credit, ML & AI
jobs.description:
In a perfect world there would be no credit. All credit is bad by nature and you do well in avoiding it as much as you can. In a perfect world, credit and the companies that provide it wouldn’t exist. We wouldn’t either.

But we don’t live in a perfect world. From time to time, we all need a helping hand to make ends meet and to make dreams become a reality. From time to time, we all need a life-happens credit buffer.

*“Just make sure it’s a fair one.”*

### **Who we are**

Fairlo is a fintech active in Sweden and the UK, helping people access sustainable finances. Our edge comes from transparency and flexibility towards the customer, and from our in-house credit decision engine and the machine-learning models that power it.

### **Where we are now**

Since launching in 2018 we’ve helped tens of thousands of customers access responsible credit when life happens. We have 50,000+ active users, a 4.7 Trustpilot rating from 4,500+ reviews and an incredibly low churn rate. Transparency and flexibility aren’t just the right thing to do; they’re a winning model.

We’re a tight team of 50 in Stockholm, Crete and the UK, backed by some of Sweden’s most experienced investors. Our culture prizes kindness, courage, collaboration and common sense.

### **Where we’re going**

In line with new legislation and our long-term vision, we’re entering a new chapter of growth on the road to becoming a bank. That means scaling responsibly and putting AI to work where it makes credit fairer: sharper risk decisions, faster underwriting and better customer outcomes, all while staying true to our mission of a fairer world, even when it comes to money.

### **The role**

You’ll join the Credit team as we bring our decision engine fully under Credit’s ownership. You’ll own the models, data parsers and AI tooling that decide who we lend to, and how much, across two regulated markets.

We build with AI every day. Our credit team ships with AI coding agents, and we use large language models to turn messy, unstructured data (bank statements, open banking transactions, customer documents) into signal our models can use. We want someone who is excited to push that further, and rigorous enough to do it in a regulated lender.

### **What you’ll do**

Own projects end-to-end, from the first query to production and monitoring:

* **Data and features.** Analyse large datasets, engineer features and build robust data pipelines.
* **Credit models.** Develop, validate and improve ML models for risk, affordability and limit decisions.
* **LLM-powered extraction.** Use LLMs to parse and categorise unstructured financial data, with evaluation sets that prove it works.
* **AI-assisted engineering.** Use agents like Claude Code and Cursor to move faster, and help the team adopt what works.
* **Responsible AI.** Keep models explainable, fair and monitored, ready for regulators and auditors.
* **Production.** Use CI/CD for testing, deployment and monitoring of models in AWS.
* **Collaboration.** Work with risk, product and engineering to break complex problems into shippable steps.

### **What we believe you bring**

* Fluency in Python and SQL
* Experience taking ML models into production, not just notebooks
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Snowflake Cortex or similar) in your daily work, and opinions on where they help and where they don’t
* Experience building with LLMs: prompting, structured extraction, retrieval or evaluation
* Experience running software in AWS, or a strong desire to learn

### **Even better if you have**

* Experience in banking, credit or another regulated industry
* Knowledge of model risk management, explainability or fairness testing
* Familiarity with the EU AI Act, which treats credit scoring as high-risk

### **Joining Fairlo means**

* Being part of building the financial world you would like to live in.
* Health insurance, pension at ITP level and a health and wellness allowance
* 30 days of vacation per year plus klämdagar off
* The possibility to use the Fairlo Cretan house for both work and vacation stays
* The possibility of bike leasing
* A hybrid working model with a top-location office in Stockholm
* Being part of a team that supports one another, has fun together and thrives

### **Where you’ll work**

Mostly in our Stockholm office, with occasional travel to our tech hub in Crete and the UK. We offer a hybrid model, competitive benefits and, most importantly, a deeply supportive and purpose-driven culture.

At SAS, we're passionate about transforming aviation with cutting-edge technology. As part of our AI Team, you'll shape the future of air travel by creating innovative, data-driven solutions that maximize revenue.

Your work will ensure that the airline's Revenue Optimization remains scientifically robust, operationally scalable, and commercially impactful, directly shaping how revenue is optimized in a dynamic, competitive marketplace.

 A priority will be to deliver dynamic pricing, a groundbreaking shift in how SAS competes in the marketplace. At the same time, we are developing AI-driven revenue optimization at scale, ensuring our models continuously learn, adapt, and evolve with industry dynamics.

 Machine Learning & Optimization Techniques

 From classical ensemble methods to deep learning architectures and reinforcement learning frameworks, you'll select the most effective approach for each complex problem. 
 Operations Research

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer - Frontend focus
jobs.description:
Konsert Strategy & IP is a leading consultancy at the intersection of business strategy, technology and intellectual property. Founded in Gothenburg in 2006, we work with some of the world's largest technology-intensive companies, close to the leaders who decide where to compete and how to win through technology and IP. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group.

Like every consultancy, we are adapting to an environment that AI is reshaping. Much of the research, analysis and preparation that used to fill a project team's weeks can now be done by machines.

Our clients face the same shift from the other side. Their strategy, technology and IP functions are under a clear mandate to work faster and leaner with AI. But today's landscape of point tools depends on the user to supply the context, and without it the tools speed up the doing without improving the thinking.

What clients still need is sound judgment, grounded in the right context. That is where the real value of AI lies: not in faster work, but in better, more reliable and more impactful decisions. So rather than defend the old consultancy model, we are rebuilding ours around that: consultants who work inside our clients' organizations, supported by an AI platform that holds the client's context. That platform is Sapivia. We are now growing our in-house tech team, to make sure we have the capabilities under our own roof to take Sapivia to the next level.

**What we are building: Sapivia**

Sapivia is Konsert's AI platform. At its core is the context layer: a client-specific knowledge graph that holds the context every decision depends on. How the business, its technology and its intellectual property connect, what depends on what, and the reasoning behind the decisions already made. We have built that picture for clients by hand for twenty years; Sapivia captures it, keeps it alive and makes it available to people and AI alike.

Our consultants build the context layer together with the client. The client's own people, Konsert's forward-deployed strategists and the AI tools the client already uses can then reason and act on the same picture, one that grows richer over time.

Sapivia is already in use with clients, starting in IP, where the need is sharpest. But the same picture answers the questions every technology company has to ask: which technologies matter, where to compete and how to turn knowledge into advantage. That is where we are taking it next.

**The Konsert tech core team**

We are building a small tech core team: a handful of engineers with complementary skills. The team is led by a Tech Lead and sits in Gothenburg, next to the consultants who deploy Sapivia with clients. Build work happens in close collaboration with those consultants, several of whom spend part of their time in the team, so the domain expertise and the client's reality are in the room when we build.

We work in an agile way with shared ownership: everyone is close to the users, effort goes where it is needed, and the team ships several times a week and owns the result together. Development runs in close alignment with Konsert's leadership team, with short paths to user input and quick decisions. The tech core team has a central voice in how Sapivia is shaped. Around this core, we scale with external developers and the Rouse Group's technology organization.

**Questions we are working on right now**

Giving AI the right context is only the start. Turning that context into decisions that large companies can rely on raises questions that few teams have answered yet. These are some of the ones we are working on now. They are open questions, not tickets, and you will help answer them.

* How do we assure the quality of AI responses at scale, when the right answer is often a matter of judgment?
* How do we best combine deep domain knowledge with what the models already know?
* How do we make a rich, connected body of knowledge feel simple and intuitive to work with?
* How do we give large organizations precise control over who sees what, across regions, teams and many users?
* How do we shorten the path from prototype to production code, while keeping the freedom to experiment?

**The role: Fullstack Developer - Frontend focus**

You bring the frontend depth to the core team. Sapivia's users are experts working with a lot of connected information at once, and the interfaces are where the context layer and the AI become usable. You shape how Sapivia's frontends, each built for a different group of users, are structured, tested and shipped, work closely with the rest of the team on APIs and data, and pick up backend work when that is what moves the product forward.

**What you bring**

* Several years (likely 5+) of professional experience as a software engineer
* Strong React and TypeScript, and experience owning complex, workflow-heavy user interfaces from idea to production, ideally including visualization of connected or graph-shaped data
* Experience building against a typed API contract (OpenAPI or similar) and working with the rest of the team on its shape
* A working understanding of enterprise authentication flows, for example Microsoft Entra ID or other OIDC-based single sign-on
* Experience with automated end-to-end testing, for example Playwright, and with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience using AI tools as a natural part of your development work

**Who we are looking for**

You are an experienced engineer who has shipped software that real users depend on. Where you have worked matters less than what you have built. If you are more senior and want to shape a platform and a team from an early stage, we would like to talk to you too.

Beyond that, we look for four things:

* You share ownership of the outcome. You care about what the team ships, not only your part of it, and you help get the work done where it is needed.
* You are curious about the domain and the users. You want to understand what a better decision looks like for the people we build for, and you like working with consultants as closely as with other engineers.
* You use AI seriously in your own work, and you understand that AI in a product is only valuable when it is reliable and well grounded. Evaluation and guardrails interest you as much as capability does.
* You like building. You take initiative, form a view and can explain it, and you are comfortable when the playbook is still being written.

If most of this describes you, please get in touch. Nobody matches every line, and we would rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out.

**Why Konsert**

**Help shape the model.** We are building a service and a technology business together. The platform you build is what our consultants deploy, and your engineering judgment will shape our methods, our product and what we offer next.

**See it in use.** You will see your work in clients' real decisions and operations, and hear from the consultants next to you how it lands.

**Responsibility, with experience beside you.** We are a team of around twenty with a flat structure. You will take on responsibility early, with a Tech Lead and senior colleagues to support you.

**A solid base.** Konsert has an established position in technology strategy and business-driven IP, and Sapivia is already in use with clients. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group, which gives us specialist expertise, technology resources and a wider client network.

jobs.title: Performance Management / Data Mediation Engineer - 20125
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
An experienced Performance Management / Data Mediation Engineer is needed for a consulting assignment focused on developing and maintaining data pipelines for performance data in a complex network and OSS environment. The role is responsible for building robust, scalable flows for collecting, transforming, and making performance data available from network elements and adjacent systems. The resulting data must be reliable, traceable, and usable for both operational monitoring and analytical purposes.
You will work across multiple data sources and integration patterns, contributing to the continued development of in-house capabilities, onboarding new data sources, and improving existing data models and flows. A key objective is to reduce dependency on external vendors by developing and maintaining internal solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, operate, maintain, and enhance data pipelines for network performance data.
Collect, transform, validate, and expose data from network elements and surrounding systems.
Implement integrations using protocols and patterns including SNMP, traps, REST APIs, file-based transfers, and streaming telemetry.
Ensure data reliability, traceability, quality, lineage, governance, and appropriate schema design.
Integrate performance-data solutions with adjacent inventory, topology, ITSM, and analytics systems.
Onboard new data sources and further develop existing data models, integrations, and operational flows.
Collaborate closely with architects, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and performance analysts to prioritize improvements and evolve the solution.
Contribute to knowledge transfer and the development of internal engineering capability.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Strong practical experience with Python, SQL, and ETL/ELT-based data processing.
Experience with data-pipeline scheduling and job orchestration.
Solid understanding of SNMP, MIBs, polling, traps, and streaming telemetry.
Experience with data quality, data lineage, data governance, and schema development.
Good understanding of DevOps principles and modern development and operations practices.
Experience with performance-management platforms such as OpenText NNMi/NOM, OPTIC Data Lake, or equivalent platforms is advantageous.
Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka, MQ, or similar message buses is advantageous.
Experience with time-series and observability tooling such as Grafana, Prometheus, or the ELK Stack is advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience
Documented experience designing and maintaining data pipelines within OSS, telecommunications performance management, or related network analytics environments is required. The ideal candidate combines data-engineering expertise with a practical understanding of network data collection and mediation. Fluent English communication skills are required. Additional Nordic or Baltic language skills are considered advantageous.

jobs.title: Data Analyst & Steward
jobs.description:
Scope and Impact
You are an autonomous contributor holding end-to-end stewardship accountability for an assigned scope, on behalf of the business owners of that data. You balance stewardship responsibilities, analytics delivery, and self-service enablement while maximizing business value from data through trusted metrics, high-quality data products, and adoption of analytical solutions.
You may sit within a regional IT organization or directly within the business domain, depending on structure.
As a domain resource, you receive governance standards, tooling, and escalation support from the central Data & AI Governance function, Global Data & AI Platform team and the visualization engineering CoE.


What you do
Metrics & Data Products
Align existing and new metric definitions across teams so everyone works from the same numbers.
Curate metric definitions, metadata, and the semantic layer so they're reliable enough for AI agents to answer business questions directly, not just for human dashboard users.
Act as Data Steward for all data products within your assigned sub-domain.
Monitor and improve data quality through controls and remediation activities, elevating data quality and data management from source to the analytical layer.
Maintain metadata, data lineage, business glossaries, and ownership information within the enterprise data catalog.
Track and demonstrate the business value and ROI realized from the data products you steward, using this evidence to prioritize improvements or retirement.
Partner with Data Engineers to define the semantic layer in the global data and AI platform and understand how they built data models and pipelines.
Review and coordinate data access approvals and stewardship workflows in accordance with governance policies and business ownership responsibilities.



Analytical Solutions
Support business stakeholders with complex, non-standard analytical questions that go beyond self-service, applying analytical rigor to validate findings before they inform decisions.
Drive adoption of self-service analytics developed with data engineers.
Build and maintain complex dashboards and analytical solutions.
Validate that self-service and analytical outputs remain accurate when consumed by AI agents, not only by human users.



Data Literacy 
Take ownership for growing data literacy within your sub-domain.
Train and support business users on self-service analytics solutions



AI-readiness & Ways of Working 
Proactively automates routine parts of their own workflow (quality checks, documentation updates, recurring reporting) using agentic AI, and prototypes solutions live with business stakeholders using AI instead of running a traditional multi-week build cycle.



Where you will be
This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
 
Benefits highlights
Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
Comprehensive insurance coverage.
Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
Access to in-house sports facilities.

 


 
As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.description:
Company description:

Position Type:  Student

Scope: Master thesis, 30 ECTS, 20 weeks. 
 
Job description: 
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.   
 
Who are we? 
Our focus on Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity allows each of us the opportunity to bring our full authentic self to work and thrive by providing a safe and supportive environment, free of harassment and discrimination.  
At the Group Driving Performance & Aero, we hold the responsibility for the core feature of Energy Economy, Driving Range, CO2/GHG Emissions, Drivability, Average Speed and Aerodynamic AirDrag testing. Our work spans feature management, complete vehicle testing for aero, soiling, energy efficiency, and range. Additionally, we specialize in developing and executing state-of-the-art complete vehicle simulations, utilizing cutting-edge software in the loop and hardware in the loop technologies. 
We embrace change and agility, staying responsive to emerging challenges and opportunities. We offer mentorship and growth opportunities, creating an environment where you can learn from experienced professionals while contributing to cutting-edge projects shaping the future of the automotive industry. 
Join us and be part of a dynamic team where diversity, creativity, and innovation drive our success. We actively encourage engineers of all backgrounds to apply and be instrumental in shaping the future of automotive technology. 
 
The challenge 
Volvo Group certifies aerodynamic drag (CdA) for heavy-duty trucks under EU VECTO regulations through physical testing at proving grounds. We have accumulated a substantial dataset of CdA measurements paired with detailed weather data and logged continuous signals. The aim is to push our understanding further by investigating how much of the test spread and test-to-test variation is driven by environmental conditions. 
 
What you will do 
You will work with a large, real-world dataset of aerodynamic test results, as well as weather measurements and continuous logged signals from repeated test runs of a vehicle. Your task is to analyze the data and investigate the physical mechanisms behind CdA variation, due to transient effects for instance. 
 
The work includes:  
Statistical analysis of CdA variation against environmental variables across multiple proving grounds 
Segment-by-segment signal analysis within individual test runs to identify transient effects that run-averaged data masks 
Decomposing CdA scatter into aerodynamic environmental effects, and non-aerodynamic confounders, and unexplained residual 
Cross-referencing findings with an existing ML correlation and prediction model  
 
Who you are 
 Master's student in Engineering Physics, Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Mechanical Engineering, or similar 
 Strong in Python, comfortable working with large, real-world datasets that need cleaning and structuring 
 Solid grounding in statistics, experience in machine learning or signal analysis is a plus 
 Independent and structured in your way of working, with high drive and curiosity 
 Have a sense for the physics behind the numbers 
 
 
Ready for this challenge? 
Send your application today!  We will continuously review applications and conduct interviews, so don't wait to submit yours! 
Language: English Starting date: Mid-January 2027 Number of students: 1 Last application date: November 13th.   
Ready for the next move? 
For further information please contact Rodrigo Estella, Driving Performance Group Manager, rodrigo.estella@volvo.com or Aymane Moutchou, Simulation & Analysis Engineer, aymane.moutchou@volvo.com 
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 
 
Who we are and what we believe in We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 
 
Trucks Technology & Industrial Division hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need. Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Konsert Strategy & IP is a leading consultancy at the intersection of business strategy, technology and intellectual property. Founded in Gothenburg in 2006, we work with some of the world's largest technology-intensive companies, close to the leaders who decide where to compete and how to win through technology and IP. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group.

Like every consultancy, we are adapting to an environment that AI is reshaping. Much of the research, analysis and preparation that used to fill a project team's weeks can now be done by machines.

Our clients face the same shift from the other side. Their strategy, technology and IP functions are under a clear mandate to work faster and leaner with AI. But today's landscape of point tools depends on the user to supply the context, and without it the tools speed up the doing without improving the thinking.

What clients still need is sound judgment, grounded in the right context. That is where the real value of AI lies: not in faster work, but in better, more reliable and more impactful decisions. So rather than defend the old consultancy model, we are rebuilding ours around that: consultants who work inside our clients' organizations, supported by an AI platform that holds the client's context. That platform is Sapivia. We are now growing our in-house tech team, to make sure we have the capabilities under our own roof to take Sapivia to the next level.

**What we are building: Sapivia**

Sapivia is Konsert's AI platform. At its core is the context layer: a client-specific knowledge graph that holds the context every decision depends on. How the business, its technology and its intellectual property connect, what depends on what, and the reasoning behind the decisions already made. We have built that picture for clients by hand for twenty years; Sapivia captures it, keeps it alive and makes it available to people and AI alike.

Our consultants build the context layer together with the client. The client's own people, Konsert's forward-deployed strategists and the AI tools the client already uses can then reason and act on the same picture, one that grows richer over time.

Sapivia is already in use with clients, starting in IP, where the need is sharpest. But the same picture answers the questions every technology company has to ask: which technologies matter, where to compete and how to turn knowledge into advantage. That is where we are taking it next.

**The Konsert tech core team**

We are building a small tech core team: a handful of engineers with complementary skills. The team is led by a Tech Lead and sits in Gothenburg, next to the consultants who deploy Sapivia with clients. Build work happens in close collaboration with those consultants, several of whom spend part of their time in the team, so the domain expertise and the client's reality are in the room when we build.

We work in an agile way with shared ownership: everyone is close to the users, effort goes where it is needed, and the team ships several times a week and owns the result together. Development runs in close alignment with Konsert's leadership team, with short paths to user input and quick decisions. The tech core team has a central voice in how Sapivia is shaped. Around this core, we scale with external developers and the Rouse Group's technology organization.

**Questions we are working on right now**

Giving AI the right context is only the start. Turning that context into decisions that large companies can rely on raises questions that few teams have answered yet. These are some of the ones we are working on now. They are open questions, not tickets, and you will help answer them.

* How do we assure the quality of AI responses at scale, when the right answer is often a matter of judgment?
* How do we best combine deep domain knowledge with what the models already know?
* How do we make a rich, connected body of knowledge feel simple and intuitive to work with?
* How do we give large organizations precise control over who sees what, across regions, teams and many users?
* How do we shorten the path from prototype to production code, while keeping the freedom to experiment?

**The role: Backend Developer**

You bring the backend and platform foundations to the core team: APIs, data models and services that can grow, built in Azure with CI/CD. Our clients are large corporations and their security requirements are part of what it takes to sell the product, so secure by default is a way of working, not a phase. You work on the data layer, including the context graph the applications run on, on tenant isolation and access control, and on how AI features are served and scaled.

**What you bring**

* Several years (likely 5+) of professional experience as a software engineer
* Strong backend development in .NET and C# and in TypeScript and Node
* Experience designing and running multi-tenant systems, with data isolation, role-based access control and audit logging treated as first-class concerns
* Experience with document and graph databases, for example MongoDB, including data modeling and query performance
* A solid foundation in secure development: authentication and authorization (for example Entra ID), secrets management, secure coding
* Experience with Azure (App Service, Key Vault, storage), CI/CD in Azure DevOps or similar, and infrastructure as code; vector search and API contract design (OpenAPI) are a plus
* Experience using AI tools as a natural part of your development work

**Who we are looking for**

You are an experienced engineer who has shipped software that real users depend on. Where you have worked matters less than what you have built. If you are more senior and want to shape a platform and a team from an early stage, we would like to talk to you too.

Beyond that, we look for four things:

* You share ownership of the outcome. You care about what the team ships, not only your part of it, and you help get the work done where it is needed.
* You are curious about the domain and the users. You want to understand what a better decision looks like for the people we build for, and you like working with consultants as closely as with other engineers.
* You use AI seriously in your own work, and you understand that AI in a product is only valuable when it is reliable and well grounded. Evaluation and guardrails interest you as much as capability does.
* You like building. You take initiative, form a view and can explain it, and you are comfortable when the playbook is still being written.

If most of this describes you, please get in touch. Nobody matches every line, and we would rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out.

**Why Konsert**

**Help shape the model.** We are building a service and a technology business together. The platform you build is what our consultants deploy, and your engineering judgment will shape our methods, our product and what we offer next.

**See it in use.** You will see your work in clients' real decisions and operations, and hear from the consultants next to you how it lands.

**Responsibility, with experience beside you.** We are a team of around twenty with a flat structure. You will take on responsibility early, with a Tech Lead and senior colleagues to support you.

**A solid base.** Konsert has an established position in technology strategy and business-driven IP, and Sapivia is already in use with clients. Since 2024 we have been part of the international Rouse Group, which gives us specialist expertise, technology resources and a wider client network.

*Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.*

Vi söker en Data Engineer som vill vara med och bygga framtidens dataplattformar och skapa förutsättningar för datadrivna beslut, avancerad analys och AI. Här får du utveckla moderna datalösningar och bidra till hur vi använder data för att skapa värde och driva utvecklingen framåt inom Saab.

**Din roll**
------------

Som Data Engineer blir du en del av vårt Enterprise Data & Analytics-team, där du tillsammans med dataingenjörer, BI-utvecklare, data scientists och verksamhetsexperter utvecklar och vidareutvecklar vår gemensamma dataplattform.

Du får en central roll i att skapa skalbara och tillförlitliga dataflöden som möjliggör rapportering, analys, automatisering och framtida AI-lösningar. Arbetet sträcker sig från integration av olika verksamhetssystem till utveckling av datamodeller och återanvändbara dataprodukter.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

* Utveckla, bygga och underhålla datapipelines och integrationer mellan olika system
* Utveckla datamodeller och återanvändbara dataprodukter för olika verksamhetsområden
* Arbeta med SQL, Python och moderna tekniker för databehandling
* Bidra till utvecklingen av vår dataplattform med fokus på Microsoft Fabric och Azure
* Samarbeta med verksamheten för att omsätta behov till hållbara tekniska lösningar
Skapa förutsättningar för avancerad analys, automatisering och AI-baserade lösningar  

Du får möjlighet att påverka både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt i en verksamhet där data får en allt viktigare roll.

**Din profil**
--------------

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av Data Engineering och som trivs med att kombinera teknisk problemlösning med verksamhetsförståelse. Du är nyfiken, analytisk och tycker om att samarbeta med andra för att skapa lösningar som gör verklig nytta.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:

* Data Engineering och utveckling av datapipelines
* SQL, databasutveckling och datamodellering
* ETL/ELT-processer och Data Warehousing
* Python eller liknande programmeringsspråk
* API-integrationer och arbete med olika datakällor
Molnbaserade dataplattformar  

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

* Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services eller Power BI
* Utveckling av dataprodukter och moderna dataarkitekturer
* Integrationer mot affärssystem som IFS eller SAP
Dataanalys, Business Intelligence eller AI-baserade lösningar  

Som person är du lösningsorienterad och strukturerad med en vilja att utvecklas och lära dig nya tekniker. Du har lätt för att samarbeta och kan omsätta komplexa behov till konkreta tekniska lösningar.
  
  
*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*

  
  

### **Vad du blir en del av**

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

  
  

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med över 31,000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

  
  

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Meet the Team
Join Cisco's Webex Media engineering site in Stockholm, where we craft the meeting experience that connects people and businesses around the world. We are a highly motivated, startup‑like team within a global organization, combining the impact and resources of Cisco with the agility and camaraderie of a smaller group. Our work powers the shift to a hybrid workforce and aims to make people feel truly connected. You’ll find a friendly, supportive environment that celebrates creativity, growth, and a shared passion for building world‑class real‑time audio algorithm experiences.


Your Impact
Design, implement, and optimize VoIP audio algorithms—including adaptive jitter buffers, packet loss concealment, and codec pipelines—based on product requirements.
Perform peer code reviews and automate development workflows and quality gates.
Participate in agile ceremonies including daily stand‑ups, planning, releases, and retrospectives.
Collaborate across teams to broaden technical and soft skills through training and mentoring.



Minimum Qualifications:
MSc (or equivalent) in Software Engineering or a related field.
Hands-on experience developing VoIP or real‑time audio algorithms (e.g., adaptive jitter buffer, packet loss concealment, codec integration) in production systems.
Proficiency in C/C++ with strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
Experience with media streaming and relevant protocols for real‑time applications.
Professional verbal and written communication skills in English.
Uses AI responsibly to accelerate development.
Critically reviews AI-generated code before using it.



Preferred Qualifications:
Experience applying AI/ML to audio algorithm development or optimization in production voice systems.
Experience evaluating and tuning audio algorithms using objective metrics (e.g., POLQA, PESQ) and subjective listening tests.
Experience with close‑to‑real‑time systems and performance‑sensitive code paths.
Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.
Collaborative, friendly, and self‑directed; eager to learn and share knowledge.
Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.



Why Cisco? 
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Data Engineer / BI Consultant till Claesson & Partners
jobs.description:
Är du riktigt vass på datamodellering och vill använda din tekniska kompetens för att lösa komplexa affärsproblem? Claesson & Partners söker nu en Data Engineer / BI Consultant som vill arbeta i gränslandet mellan Data Engineering, Business Intelligence och management consulting. Här får du möjlighet att kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med verksamhetsförståelse och hjälpa några av Sveriges större företag att skapa bättre styrning och beslutsfattande med hjälp av data. Claesson & Partners är ett managementkonsultbolag specialiserat på verksamhetsstyrning och lönsamhetsutveckling.
  
  
Bolaget hjälper sina kunder att omsätta strategiska och finansiella mål till konkreta styrmodeller, KPI och beslutsunderlag. Nu vill de ytterligare stärka sin tekniska kompetens inom Data & AI och söker personer till Stockholmskontoret. Om rollen Som Data Engineer / BI Consultant arbetar du med att ta komplex data från olika delar av kundens verksamhet och omvandla den till robusta, skalbara och användbara datamodeller för analys och verksamhetsstyrning. En central del av rollen är att förstå hur data hänger ihop, hur den bör struktureras och vilka konsekvenser olika val i datamodellen får för prestanda, analys och rapportering.
  
  
Du behöver därför kunna gå längre än att enbart bygga dashboards eller implementera redan definierade krav. Du arbetar tillsammans med Claesson & Partners managementkonsulter och kundernas verksamheter för att förstå affärsproblem och därefter omsätta dem till välfungerande tekniska lösningar. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Designa och utveckla datamodeller och datalager för komplexa verksamhets- och analysbehov. Strukturera och transformera data från flera olika källsystem.
  
  
Bygga och vidareutveckla ETL/ELT-flöden och datapipelines. Arbeta hands-on med SQL och Python. Utveckla analys- och rapporteringslösningar i Power BI. Arbeta med moderna molnbaserade dataplattformar, framför allt inom Microsoft/Azure-ekosystemet.
  
  
Optimera datamodeller, SQL och dataflöden med fokus på prestanda, skalbarhet och datakvalitet. Bidra till Claesson & Partners fortsatta utveckling inom Data & AI. Vem söker vi: Du har minst några års professionell erfarenhet inom Data Engineering, Business Intelligence eller Analytics Engineering och har byggt datalösningar som används i verkliga verksamheter. För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har: Goda kunskaper i SQL.
  
  
Bra förståelse för datamodellering och hur olika modelleringsval påverkar användbarhet, prestanda och framtida utveckling. Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla datalager och analytiska datamodeller. Praktisk erfarenhet av ETL/ELT och datapipelines. Erfarenhet av Power BI och semantisk modellering.
  
  
Erfarenhet av Azure eller motsvarande modern molnbaserad dataplattform. Erfarenhet av Python för datahantering, transformation eller automation. Teknik möter verksamhet För att trivas hos Claesson & Partners behöver du vara tekniskt stark, men också nyfiken på varför datan behövs. Du behöver kunna sätta dig in i en verksamhet, förstå vilka frågor kunden försöker besvara och därefter resonera kring hur data behöver struktureras för att skapa ett tillförlitligt beslutsunderlag.
  
  
Det viktigaste är dock att du har förmågan och intresset att förstå verksamhetslogiken bakom datan. Som person tror vi att du är: Analytisk och strukturerad. Tekniskt nyfiken och problemlösande. Prestigelös och samarbetsorienterad.
  
  
Trygg i dialog med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära personer. Du behöver inte vara den som pratar mest i rummet. Däremot behöver du kunna förklara hur du tänker, argumentera för dina tekniska val och vara nyfiken nog att ifrågasätta när data eller krav inte hänger ihop. Därför Claesson & Partners Hos Claesson & Partners får du en spännande möjlighet att kombinera Data/BI-kompetens med management consulting.
  
  
Du kommer in i ett mindre och kompetent konsultbolag där beslutsvägarna är korta och där du får stort eget ansvar. I stället för att vara en liten del av en stor Data-organisation får du möjlighet att påverka hur Claesson & Partners utvecklar sitt erbjudande inom Data & AI. Du får bland annat: Arbeta med komplexa data- och verksamhetsproblem hos stora företag och koncerner. Ta stort tekniskt ansvar och påverka lösningar från ett tidigt skede.
  
  
Arbeta nära erfarna managementkonsulter och kundernas beslutsfattare. Vara med och utveckla Claesson & Partners tekniska erbjudande inom Data & AI. Arbeta i en platt organisation med stor möjlighet att påverka. Vara med och fortsätta bygga upp Stockholmskontoret.
  
  
En långsiktig utvecklingsväg. Claesson & Partners söker både dig som har kommit några år in i karriären och dig som är mer senior. Det tekniska djupet och din förmåga att lösa komplexa dataproblem är viktigare än ett visst antal år i yrket. Låter det intressant?
  
  
Vi ser fram emot att berätta mer om företaget och rollen i nästa steg av processen. Om anställningen: Detta är en direktanställning där du kommer att bli direkt anställd av kunden. Övrig info: Omfattning: Heltid, 100%, direktrekytering Start: Enligt överenskommelse Placering: Stockholm city Rekryteringsansvarig: Hedvig Svärd Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are seeking an SRE / DevOps Engineer to join an agile team developing and operating business-critical connected vehicle services. You will bridge development and operations to maximize uptime, automate workflows, and maintain robust monitoring for millions of connected vehicles worldwide.
What You Will Do
Observability: Maintain and optimize monitoring, logging, and alerting (Datadog, CloudWatch, Kibana) for rapid troubleshooting and high availability.


Automation & IaC: Streamline operations and deployments using scripting (Python/Bash) and Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform).


Operations: Run and support enterprise Linux environments and core AWS infrastructure; participate in the team's on-call rotation.


Collaboration & Security: Partner with engineers and product owners in a "you build it, you run it" culture while applying cloud security best practices (IAM, encryption).

Qualifications & Experience
Core Requirements:

AWS & Cloud Infrastructure: Solid hands-on experience designing and operating solutions in AWS, including Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation).


Automation & Scripting: Strong skills in operational automation using languages such as Python, Bash, or Java.


Observability & Reliability: Proven experience setting up distributed metrics, logging, and alerts (e.g. Datadog, CloudWatch, or Kibana).


Linux & Operations: Confident working in enterprise Linux environments with a solid grasp of basic networking (TCP/IP).


Ways of Working: Good understanding of modern DevOps culture, incident management, and agile delivery.


Communication: Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.


Meriting:

Experience with Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, API Gateway) or message brokers (MQTT, Kafka).


Familiarity with container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) or backend development in Java.


Prior experience from the automotive, telematics, or IoT domain.

Who You Are
An analytical problem solver focused on automation, root-cause resolution, and continuous improvement.


A communicative team player who takes ownership of production systems and bridges technical depth with business needs.



We are looking for consultants who are passionate about modern cloud technology, eager to tackle challenging client assignments, and drive technical excellence. Join us to work alongside leading technology companies and explore cutting-edge solutions in a supportive and innovative network.
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Privacy Analyst  Data Protection & OneTrust - 20115
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Privacy Analyst to support the Data Protection Representative (DPR) in maintaining compliance with global privacy laws and regulations. The role focuses on day-to-day privacy operations, data protection processes, and the implementation of privacy requirements across a global organization.
You will work closely with IT, Information Security, Legal & Compliance, and business stakeholders across regions, supporting privacy compliance initiatives, risk management, and continuous improvement.
What You Will Work On
Maintain and review the Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) in OneTrust, ensuring data accuracy and quality.
Manage Data Subject Requests and personal data breaches in accordance with established procedures.
Develop guidance for personal data retention and coordinate data cleansing, deletion, and sanitization activities.
Promote Privacy by Design in projects, system changes, and new products or services.
Identify privacy risks and support business and IT teams in implementing compliant solutions.
Contribute to strategic privacy projects and global compliance initiatives.
Coordinate privacy training and awareness activities.
Collaborate with Information Security, Operational Control, Legal, and Compliance teams.
Support local and regional privacy compliance initiatives and harmonize global practices.
Provide clear, practical advice on privacy matters and prepare internal newsletters and articles.
Monitor developments in global privacy legislation and understand organizational data flows and IT systems.

What You Bring
Bachelor's degree or higher.
3–5 years of professional experience in data privacy and compliance.
Strong knowledge of global privacy laws and regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, and POPIA.
Practical experience implementing or working with OneTrust.
Knowledge of information security principles and risk management.
Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work independently with minimal supervision.
Analytical, proactive, adaptable, and service-oriented working style.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a multinational and multicultural organization.

Meritorious
CIPP or other relevant privacy certifications.
Experience with additional privacy compliance and AI tools.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Epiminds
We’re building Lucy, an AI system that investigates marketing performance and carries approved changes through to execution.
Behind that work is a backend coordinating model calls, external APIs, persistent state, and code running in sandboxes. We’re a small team in Stockholm building the infrastructure this product needs.


The Problem
Agent workloads are difficult to predict. One request can become several parallel investigations. A task can pause for approval and continue later. A worker can disappear after an external API accepts a change but before the result is saved.
Retrying may duplicate the action. Giving up may leave the work unfinished. Keeping everything ready reduces latency but consumes idle compute.
The system has to know what happened, who owns the next step, and what is safe to repeat—while keeping data isolated and costs under control.


The Role
You’ll own the execution infrastructure, data systems, and reliability behind Lucy.
You’ll work across application code, databases, and cloud infrastructure, taking changes from design through deployment and operation. Your decisions will shape how the product handles more work and recovers when things fail.


What You’ll Do
Make execution durable. Build scheduling, queues, leases, cancellation, and recovery for work that outlives an individual request.
Make retries safe. Preserve execution state and prevent duplicate events from repeating external actions.
Run agent compute efficiently. Improve sandbox startup, worker scaling, resource limits, and cleanup.
Build dependable data flows. Handle pagination, partial failures, changing provider contracts, and datasets that should be streamed rather than held in memory.
Make failures explainable. Connect traces, logs, and cost data so the team can find bottlenecks and resolve incidents.

What We’re Looking For
You’ve operated backend systems in production and owned their reliability. You understand database design, distributed state, queues, and the difference between a failed request and a failed operation.
You’re comfortable with containers and cloud infrastructure. You can explain what breaks under load, how recovery works, and when a simpler design is enough.
Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Redis, Temporal, Cloud Run, GKE, Modal, Docker, and Pulumi.


Why Join Now
Execution is central to the product. You’ll shape how agents run, how their work survives failures, and how infrastructure cost changes as usage grows.


What we offer
Competitive salary and meaningful equity.
Healthcare, retirement savings, and wellbeing support.
Office catering.

Hiring process
Recruiter screening.
Technical task.
Code interview.
Trial with us in the office.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.
